note: Small Richland County park at Rockbridge, in a mowed field below a pine-topped sandstone ridge where the two branches of the Pine River meet under a natural bridge; a tunnel and stairs lead through and onto the rock. Shelters and play equipment. The county gives no site sizes or RV guidance: the sites are rustic and small, so check that a 23-ft rig fits before relying on it. --Claude
summary: County page read: 6 first-come sites, pit toilets, permit for 'a minor fee' from the store next door; no rate, season, hookups or RV/size guidance posted. Riverview kept (sites not placed; the Pine River here is a ~8-12 m stream). Stored phone 608-647-4673 unsourced; the county page lists 608-475-1487. Pin is in the park field (keep).
